title: The Shrinking Landscape of Linguistic Diversity in the Age of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating shifts in inferred gender by applying trained classifiers to original and LLM-rewritten texts, and analyzing changes in gender-associated lexical cues using dictionaries like LIWC.
Applying age-prediction classifiers to original and LLM-rewritten texts to measure systematic shifts toward specific inferred age groups, alongside analyzing age-related linguistic markers.
Measuring changes in predicted political affiliations (e.g., Democrat vs. Republican) and analyzing shifts in language markers associated with political identity after LLM rewriting.
Tracking changes in predicted Big Five personality traits, dispositional empathy, and moral values using trained classifiers and psychometric lexicons applied to original versus LLM-rewritten texts.
